messages:
olivia: Heads-up: proposing a staged "weighted fallback" rollout for the new routing config that shifts overflow to cheaper pools when quota spikes. Plan: 1% tenants for 15m -> 10% for 45m -> 50% for 2h. Need telemetry + ops + console approvals.

ryan: quick clarification: weighted fallback = percent split by route weight, not pure round-robin, right?

olivia: correct. each tenant gets a weight context, fallback will route proportionally to legacy/cheap pools. config stored as snapshot and applied via POST /internal/configs/apply.

anya: metrics we should watch: `fallback_routing_ratio`, `tenant_throttle_hits`, `cheaper_pool_capacity_util`, and top errors by tenant. Also include a panel for slowest 5 tenants affected.

jordan: telemetry note: traces will add header `X-Routing-Snapshot: snap-2026-04-02-1015`. preflight emits synthetic traffic for the canary cohort.

sam: console UX: show current snapshot id, active cohort %, and an inline "pause & revert" action that creates a revert snapshot and annotates audit. Make revert idempotent.

olivia: revert is CAS-based and returns 200 if already reverted. UI will show confirmation modal and briefly disable button to avoid double clicks.

ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: `weighted-fallback-1798889999` at 2026-04-02T10:15:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/1798889999

anya: suggested auto-pause triggers: fallback_routing_ratio deviation >5% for 10m, tenant_throttle_hits > 0.2% baseline, p99 routing latency up 40%. On auto-pause, send to #eng-oncall and post runbook link.

ryan: minor ask: include a flag to disable synthetic preflight in case we want purely production-only samples.

olivia: added `preflight=false` toggle. final checklist: runbook link, dashboard panels, snapshot apply API stable, revert button wired. launching after lunch unless objections.

sam: no objections. i'll stand by for dashboard alerts.

jordan: preflight smoke passed in staging.

olivia: ok launching at 10:15. will post updates when each phase completes.
